best_window: Early morning to late morning before wind builds
report_text:
The model expects 5-9 ft of visibility, resulting in a D grade. Elevated surf, swell energy, surface movement and wind-driven mixing are keeping visibility limited.

The rising tide is a favorable signal. As water moves toward the next high tide at 9:36 PM, cleaner offshore water may move into La Jolla and support improving visibility.

Overall, visibility is likely to remain limited and inconsistent. Sheltered coves and deeper water may hold the clearest conditions, while exposed coastline and sandy entries could be worse.
